message.content: {"ranking": [], "explanation": "No provided patch targets the module instance that produces the observed o_mosi mismatch at cycle 484124. The failure shows o_mosi=0 when 1 is expected during command byte transmission, and the o_mosi signal is driven exclusively by the llsdspi submodule (source line 90: `llsdspi lowlevel(... o_mosi ...)`). All candidate edits modify only the parent sdspi module's command/response state machines and FIFO logic (source lines 276-472, 732-811, 9010-10066, 14129-14136, 22110-23071), which feed the llsdspi inputs (ll_cmd_stb, ll_cmd_dat, ll_fifo_rd, ll_fifo_wr) but do not alter llsdspi's internal bit-serialization or SCK/MOSI timing. Because no patch edits the llsdspi module definition (which appears in the original source but has no corresponding candidate), none can change the o_mosi output trace. The static dependency analysis confirms the mismatch's first_line=276/last_line=472 range covers only the parent's response-state logic, not the low-level transmitter."}
